a.lede: Jensen Huang has been summoned to appear before Congress's Select Committee on the CCP.
a.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to Congress over affair with alleged Chinese spy

b.lede: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.
b.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns as CEO in the wake of multiple affairs, Chinese spy allegations
